VAL-SETUP-001.observed: With reservations.enabled=true on acme, /acme/settings/locations/v17plv08r5v357bie335lyq8 renders a Reservations card (data-testid=location-reservations-card, heading text 'Reservations') with a visible 'Manage reservations settings' link whose href is /acme/reservations/settings?location=v17plv08r5v357bie335lyq8; clicking it navigated to exactly that URL and the setup shell rendered. Read-only D1 pragma query: control-plane OrganizationLocation has columns id, organizationId, name, slug, phone, timezone, taxRate, address, storeHours, onlineHours, specialHours, prepTime, largeOrderThreshold, largeOrderThresholdType, largeOrderExtraPrepTime, fulfillmentOptions, inHouseTips, scheduling, deliveryConfig, deliveryZones, isActive, isDefault, createdAt, updatedAt - no reservation settings columns.
VAL-SETUP-001.notes: Flag-OFF clause not re-tested (already proven by g17 this round; org flags were left untouched by g3). Document GET of the page was 200.

VAL-SETUP-002.observed: UI save 1 from /acme/reservations/settings: slot interval 15->20 ('Slot interval (minutes)' options {5,10,15,20,30,60}) and Max advance window 60->61. Browser network capture shows PUT http://localhost:3007/operator/reservations/setup/locations/v17plv08r5v357bie335lyq8/settings -> 200 with payload expectedVersion:13, intervalMin:20, horizonDays:61; version badge 13->14, success banner 'General reservation settings saved.', rsv_audit_log row action='settings.update' changes {"version":14}. After reload both values persist (20/61, badge v14). PUT-only round trip: dayStartMin 300 + releaseLocalMin 480 -> 200 persisted in sqlite; restored 240/null -> 200. 400 probes via curl with a real setup token: intervalMin:12 -> 400 {"error":"invalid","fields":["intervalMin","interval_min"]}; horizonDays:400 -> 400 code too_big; row unchanged (20/61 at that point).
VAL-SETUP-002.notes: UI exposes enabled, online_enabled, interval_min and horizon_days; day_start_min and release_local_min are NOT rendered on settings._index.tsx (verified in DOM and source) and were verified via PUT. Both restored (final settings diff vs baseline: none).

VAL-SETUP-003.observed: Min advance notice 30->45 through the UI (save 2), PUT 200, version 14->15, audit row {"version":15}, persisted after reload and returned by GET /operator/.../settings as min_notice_min:45. same_day_cutoff_min set to 720 via PUT -> 200, persisted in sqlite, GET reflected 720; cleared to null via PUT -> 200, persisted null. All values restored (min_notice 30, same_day_cutoff null).
VAL-SETUP-003.notes: min_notice_min is UI-configurable; same_day_cutoff_min is PUT-only (no control on settings._index.tsx). The 'immediately governs searchAvailability for the online channel' effect was not exercised by this group (belongs to route-test/behavioral surfaces).

VAL-SETUP-004.observed: UI: Online max party size 8->9 and Max party size (host stand) 20->22 (save 2), PUT 200, persisted after reload. PUT round trip for the remaining named fields: largePartyMode 'contact'->'request', largePartyNoteI18n {en,ar}, requestHoldsCapacity true->false, requestDeadlineHours 24->48, contactPhone set, publicNoteI18n {en,ar}, seatingPrefMode 'off'->'preferred' -> 200, sqlite + GET reflected all; restored to originals -> 200. Rejections via curl: onlinePartyMin:12 (> max 9) -> 400 invalid_party_bounds; onlinePartyMax:23 (> party_max 22) -> 400 invalid_party_bounds; row unchanged in both cases.
VAL-SETUP-004.notes: UI exposes online_party_min, online_party_max and party_max only; large_party_mode, large_party_note_i18n, request_holds_capacity, request_deadline_hours, contact_phone, public_note_i18n and seating_pref_mode are PUT-only (UI gap, see friction). Only 'preferred' was round-tripped; 'strict' shares the same zod enum path.

VAL-SETUP-005.observed: UI: Arrival grace period 15->20 and Checkout hold TTL 420->480 s (hold_minutes 7->8), PUT 200, persisted after reload. auto_no_show_after_min toggled null -> 45 via PUT (200, sqlite 45, GET 45) -> null (200, sqlite null). Rejections via curl: holdMinutes:1 -> 400 {"error":"invalid", code too_small}; holdMinutes:25 -> 400 code too_big; hold_minutes unchanged. payment_hold 20->25, voice_hold 15->16, freeze 30->31 -> 200 persisted, restored 20/15/30.
VAL-SETUP-005.notes: UI exposes hold_minutes (as TTL seconds) and late_grace_min; payment_hold_minutes, voice_hold_minutes, freeze_min and auto_no_show_after_min are PUT-only (UI gap). All restored.

VAL-SETUP-006.observed: UI: Cancellation cutoff 2 h -> 3 h (guest_modify_cutoff_min 120->180), PUT 200, persisted after reload. PUT round trip: maxActivePerPhone 3->4, blockSamePhoneOverlap true->false, contactStatusesEnabled true->false, courseStatusesEnabled true->false -> 200, sqlite + GET reflected all four; restored 3/true/true/true -> 200 (re-read immediately before restoring; contact/course were 0/0 from my write).
VAL-SETUP-006.notes: guest_modify_cutoff_min is UI-configurable (hours input). max_active_per_phone, block_same_phone_overlap, contact_statuses_enabled and course_statuses_enabled are NOT rendered anywhere in settings._index.tsx, so the required accessibility-snapshot evidence for those values could not be produced in the UI; they were confirmed through the PUT/GET network responses instead (clause 'reflects the updated toggles immediately in the settings UI' is only satisfiable via GET). g6 concurrently toggles contact/course; values re-read before and after and restored to 1/1.

VAL-SETUP-008.observed: UI on /acme/reservations/settings/tables: created 'G3-Area' (EN + AR 'منطقة جي3', Indoor, Bookable online) -> POST /locations/:id/areas 201, row rendered; defaults in sqlite: canvas_w 1200, canvas_h 800, online_bookable 1, guest_selectable 1, sort 5, archived_at null. Edit: renamed via row Edit -> PUT 200 (name + nameI18n.en updated), then renamed back -> PUT 200. Reorder: 'Move area up' -> two PUTs 200 swapped sort with G17-Area (5<->3); 'Move area down' -> restored (G17-Area 3, G3-Area 5). Archive: DELETE /locations/:id/areas/area_bbbfe6dc... 200, archived_at=1792193672735, cascade archivedAt to its 4 tables, UI feedback 'Dining area archived.' and the row disappeared from the active list; GET ?includeArchived=true returns it with name_i18n {en,ar}, canvas_w 1200, canvas_h 800, online_bookable true, guest_selectable true. PUT-only round trip: guestSelectable false + canvasW 1000 + canvasH 700 -> 200 persisted; restored true/1200/800 -> 200.
VAL-SETUP-008.notes: Edit form only exposes the name; guest_selectable/canvas_w/canvas_h are PUT-only (verified by round trip). Archived area and its tables are excluded from the active lists while rows and FKs are preserved. G3-Area left archived (owned resource).

VAL-SETUP-009.observed: UI: created G3-T2 (2/2), G3-T4 (2/4), G3-T3 (1/2) in G3-Area with Combinable+Online checked -> POST /locations/:id/tables 201 each; row edit G3-T2 max 2->3 -> PUT 200 (then back 2/2); archived the original G3-T3 -> DELETE 200, archived_at=1792193614430; created a new table reusing label 'G3-T3' -> POST 201, new row tbl_544bffee-... with archived_at NULL. Curl rejects with a real setup token: duplicate active label G3-T2 -> 409 duplicate_table_label; minCovers 4 > maxCovers 2 -> 400 invalid_capacity; maxCovers 100 -> 400 too_big; resetBufferMin 130 -> 400 too_big; no rows were created. PUT round trip: priority 5 + resetBufferMin 45 + shape 'rect' -> 200 persisted; restored 0/0/'square' -> 200.
VAL-SETUP-009.notes: UI create form exposes label/min/max/shape/combinable/online; priority and reset_buffer_min are PUT-only. Reusing an archived label succeeded as specified. Both G3-T3 rows ended archived by the later G3-Area archive cascade.

VAL-SETUP-010.observed: UI: created 'G3-Combo' (min 3, max 6) with members G3-T2+G3-T4 -> POST /locations/:id/combos 201; rsv_table_combos row cmb_b8c36032-... and the two rsv_table_combo_members rows verified in sqlite. Edit: PUT maxCovers 8 -> 200 persisted, restored 6 -> 200. Archive: UI 'Delete' -> DELETE /locations/:id/combos/:id 200, archived_at=1792193665030 (soft archive; member rows preserved). Curl rejects: 1 member -> 400 'invalid' code too_small; archived member (original G3-T3) -> 400 table_not_combinable; non-combinable member (seeded C1) -> 400 table_not_combinable; duplicate member set {G3-T2,G3-T4} -> 409 duplicate_combination; no bad combos persisted.
VAL-SETUP-010.notes: The combo card offers create + Delete (archive) only; edit (min/max/online/priority/members) is PUT-only - exercised via PUT for maxCovers. Delete is a soft archive per the service (archived_at set), matching the contract's 'archive' clause.

friction.description: settings._index.tsx renders only a curated subset of rsv_location_settings. Not rendered anywhere in the App UI (PUT-only): day_start_min, release_local_min (VAL-SETUP-002); same_day_cutoff_min (003); large_party_mode, large_party_note_i18n, request_holds_capacity, request_deadline_hours, contact_phone, public_note_i18n, seating_pref_mode (004); payment_hold_minutes, voice_hold_minutes, freeze_min, auto_no_show_after_min (005); max_active_per_phone, block_same_phone_overlap, contact_statuses_enabled, course_statuses_enabled (006). VAL-SETUP-006's clause 'reflects the updated toggles immediately in the settings UI' and its accessibility-snapshot evidence item are therefore not satisfiable in the UI; every field was instead round-tripped through the real tenant-api PUT and verified by read-only sqlite + GET.
friction.resolution: Verified via the PUT surface with a real setup-scope operator token and recorded which path each field used; no product code changed.

friction.resolution: Clicked the snapshot ref and scoped selectors like [data-testid=setup-area-row-G3-Area] button[aria-label=Move area up].

friction.description: rsv_location_settings is shared with concurrent validators: the settings row version advanced 7->13->27 during the session (g6 settings.update writes and a floor-plan group's floor_plan.save), so UI draft versions can go stale mid-flow; expected per the round's isolation notes, handled by reloading before each UI save.
friction.resolution: Reloaded the settings page before each UI save and restored values via PUT diffed against a captured baseline (final diff empty).

summary: Tested 9 assertions (VAL-SETUP-001..006, 008, 009, 010): 9 pass. UI save on /acme/reservations/settings returns browser-visible PUT 200 with incremented version, audit-log 'settings.update' rows and persisted values across reloads; invalid grid/party/hold values and all area/table/combo constraint cases return 400/409 with no rows written; areas/tables/combos CRUD incl. reorder, archive, archived-label reuse and member-set validation verified through the tables UI and tenant-api. All rsv_location_settings values restored to the captured baseline (final diff empty) and seeded areas/tables/combos/reservations untouched. One systemic friction: settings._index.tsx exposes only a curated subset of the settings fields (18 named fields are PUT-only), noted per assertion.
